description: This file contains utility functions for exporting notes and attachments in the Notesnook project, including content processing, path resolution, and export generation.

classes.name: ExportableItem
classes.description: Union type for exportable notes and attachments

classes.name: ExportableNote
classes.description: Type representing a note ready for export with path, timestamps, and data

classes.name: ExportableAttachment
classes.description: Type representing an attachment ready for export with path, timestamps, and data

methods.name: exportNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously exports multiple notes, yielding export objects or errors

methods.name: exportNote
methods.description: Exports a single note, yielding an export object or error

methods.name: exportContent
methods.description: Processes and retrieves the content of a note in specified format, resolving attachments and internal links
